summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload at install time
details: Package advertises itself as a Vue regex UI component library (index.js exports RegexBuilder). package.json declares preinstall="node setup.mjs". setup.mjs is obfuscated (hex-name identifiers, string-array rotation) and at install time downloads the Bun runtime v1.3.13 from the oven-sh GitHub release archive, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and then execs a sibling 727KB obfuscated file math_init.js under that downloaded Bun binary. math_init.js is a single-scope obfuscator-style bundle (hex identifiers, large constant array with a rotation function) not referenced by index.js and never loaded by Node — its only invocation path is the Bun subprocess launched from preinstall. Fetching a second runtime purely to execute a hidden obfuscated sibling file at install time bypasses Node-based auditing and has no relationship to the advertised regex-UI functionality.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
